title: Check this AI built game I spotted on X
author: loontoon
selftext: Not mine but thought it looked good.

comments.author: superkickstart
comments.body: Calling this ai built is misleading. The author says ai helped with the rc controller implementation.

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body: I guess, although he did use some AI even if it's not the type of AI use that would be common for other game devs.

replies.author: alexpopescu801
replies.body: "he did use some AI" vs "AI built". Make up your mind and stop making misleading posts

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
He clearly said he used some AI.  

Some people don't like any AI to be used in games but as this is an AI game dev sub, I thought people would find it interesting. 

If you don't that's fine.  Not sure if you are for or against AI.

replies.author: alexpopescu801
replies.body: Using "some AI" vs "AI built" are two different directions entirely. Make up your mind. Is it a game made by AI? Or a game made by a real developer with the help of "some AI"? Your post title says it's been AI built

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
He starts his post with "First weekend building with Fable (it also helped put together this video)" 

That to me reads as if he built it with AI.
